name: Mission Briefing
oracle_text: Surveil 2, then choose an instant or sorcery card in your graveyard. You may cast it this turn. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. (To surveil 2, look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)
blocked_sentences: Surveil 2, then choose an instant or sorcery card in your graveyard. You may cast it this turn. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead

needs.what: a flag on the `grant_playable` (and `exile`) play permission meaning "if a spell cast under this permission would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead" -- carried onto the StackItem as `exiles_instead` for the cast that used the permission, so it applies on resolution, on being countered and on fizzling
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `surveil` and `grant_playable` over a one-card graveyard selector cover the first two sentences, and `as_flashback` sets `obj.playable_exiles`, but that flag is read only in `stack._place_after_resolution`; the countered path (`ops_stack` counter) and the fizzle path read only `StackItem.exiles_instead`, so a countered or fizzled spell cast this way would return to the graveyard and could be cast again. `cast_card`/`cast_from_hand` carry `exiles` (StackItem.exiles_instead) but cast immediately for free during resolution rather than granting a cast-this-turn permission at the printed cost
